dialogue_texts: The flow of moments is pooling together like spilled ink on a canvas.
Someone is clumsily trying to freeze a night that doesn't belong to them.
"Clumsily" is putting it lightly, My Majesty.
The space-time fabric around the Shirogane Manor is undergoing severe structural failure.
The glohm is attempting to lock this entire area into a permanent temporal loop.
Stray variables... Intruders tracking dirt across the threshold of a flawless equation.
You speak of a flawless formula, yet your calculations are completely choked by the weight of finite boundaries.
Watch out, My Majesty! That's Helene Black, but she's completely saturated with glohm.
Her temporal signatures are completely overlapping with the core's anomaly. She can't hear you.
Eternity is an illusion born from imperfect tracking.
The axes must be shattered so the true foundation can rise.
Calling eternity an illusion in front of an exile of the Moon? Oh, you are a bold little variable, aren't you?
Let us see if your precious math can calculate the weight of an infinite, unmoving instant!
Let us see if your stagnant history can withstand the pressure of absolute variance!
